title: ShadowOutput
description: Output schema for the go-anything shadow command.

unit_id.description: Target migration unit for shadow testing.

active.description: Whether live traffic shadowing is currently active for this unit.

port.description: TCP port on which the shadow listener or target proxy is bound.

sample_rate.description: Fraction of incoming traffic sampled for shadow execution (0.0 to 1.0).

requests_total.description: Total number of incoming requests intercepted by the front door.

total_requests.description: Total number of incoming requests intercepted by the front door (alias).

requests_shadowed.description: Total number of requests asynchronously mirrored to the ported unit.

shadowed.description: Total number of requests asynchronously mirrored to the ported unit (alias).

overflow_dropped.description: Requests discarded due to bounded worker queue saturation.

mismatches_count.description: Total number of behavioral discrepancies detected during shadow execution.

mismatches.description: Total number of behavioral discrepancies detected during shadow execution (alias).

reports_path.description: Directory or file where shadow mismatch logs are persisted.
